title: A stop outside service
body: SECONDARY ORDER — Municipal Annex, elevator car 2. At 00:59:57 the car stopped above Floor 11. The service field reads FLOOR 12. Requesting operator: your terminal ID. You were not on shift yet.

choices.label: Clear it as an out-of-range sensor fault.

outcome.text: The field corrects itself to FLOOR 11 before your confirmation finishes. For one frame, a restricted attachment reads: FIELD VISIT — SENIOR OPERATOR ONLY.

choices.label: Trace the request before filing it.

outcome.text: The request carries your terminal ID, your timestamp format, and a signature shaped like yours. The attachment ends at a clearance seal: SENIOR OPERATOR. A new line appears in your file: PROMOTION REVIEW ACTIVE.
